en: A colored historical illustration of a bustling harborfront in a colonial-era city. Tall‑masted sailing ships and small boats crowd the water, while people in traditional East Asian clothing with conical hats move along the quay. The waterfront is lined with large European‑style neoclassical buildings and a prominent clock‑tower-like structure on the right. A red flag flies from a tall mast in the foreground. Behind the waterfront, the city climbs up a hillside with more colonial buildings and a church on the ridge, and there is a fortified-looking structure on a hill to the left.
